fidelity: high visual · low-mid interaction · 1 screen · fixed data
tools: Plus Design System (built directly, no Figma source)
prd: Inline PRD — Student Progress Dashboard (desktop web, tutor reviews assigned students across sessions)
description: Desktop Progress screen for a PLUS tutor: a roster of assigned students sorted worst-first, each with name, sessions completed, and a three-state progress badge. Clicking a student expands their last 5 sessions (date, topic, outcome) in place; a single 'Needs attention' toggle narrows the roster to students not on track. Includes the no-assigned-students empty state.

components.role: Tutor app shell (top bar + sidebar) — rendered, entirely non-functional
Filter toggle and the prototype-only demo state switch

interactions: Click a student row → expands their last 5 sessions in place; single-open (opening another closes the first)
'Needs attention' toggle → shows only students not on track (needs-attention + at-risk), with a live 'Showing N of M' count
Toggling the filter collapses an open student the filter is about to hide
Demo state switch: Assigned students / No students (prototype-only, not a shipped control)
outOfScope: Toolkit shell behavior — the shell renders for context but no navigation, tab switching, or routing is wired
Student detail page behind the expanded row
Sorting, search, pagination, clickable session rows
Auth, assigning or removing students, session editing, at-risk notifications
Real data or persistence — the roster is a fixed module
decisions: The 'needs attention' filter shows BOTH needs-attention and at-risk students, matching the PRD's 'only students not on track'. No per-state filter chips.
Roster is sorted worst-first (at risk → needs attention → on track) so triage does not depend on scanning. Sorting is not user-controllable.
'Outcome' is modelled as a closed set — Strong / Steady / Struggled / Missed — because the PRD leaves it undefined. This is an assumption under test.
PageLayout is used because design-system/docs/patterns/layout.md requires it for full pages; the 'no toolkit shell' exclusion is honored by wiring nothing inside it.
dsGaps: No expandable-table-row component exists in the DS. Composed from Table + an injected colSpan row rather than hand-rolling a lookalike; nearest existing alternative (Accordion) loses column alignment. Consequence: Table applies onRowClick to every row, so the injected detail row carries role="button" — suppressed visually (cursor) but not removed from the a11y tree. Worth a uno-maintain intake.
openQuestions: Is 'outcome' a status, a score, or free text? Prototype assumes a closed 4-value status set.
Should 'at risk' be reachable separately from 'needs attention', or is one toggle enough?
Roster rows are role="button" without an accessible name — needs a real pattern before build.
openChecks: validate-prototype.sh reports only its first check: the script aborts under set -e because ((PASS++)) returns 0. Pre-existing, affects every prototype. The remaining checks (default export, vite.config.js, no deep imports) were run manually and pass. Filed as a follow-up task.
Storybook run-story-tests not run — this prototype adds no stories.
